notes: A fix unit is one patch with its own verification; one unit may cover several issues, one issue may name one unit.
Verification states: unverified (only delivered), pass (red-green evidence recorded), pass_upstream (verified inside upstream's release), rework_needed.
Upstream relations: unconfirmed, adopted_verbatim, adopted_with_changes, partial, independent_alternative, none_yet, in_upstream_history (upstream fixed the same thing on its own).
Branches are counted separately from units and issues; a batch verification branch carries many units, several branches may carry one unit.
